versions.changelog:
zhanfu-cdp v1.0.0

- Initial release of the zhanfu-cdp skill.
- Provides Playwright-based WebDriver automation for Zhanfu shops on Windows (≥5.2.12) and macOS (>5.2.10).
- Supports opening shops and obtaining WebDriverPort with strict process rules; automates via Playwright only after port is acquired.
- Includes detailed operational constraints, supported actions, and macOS-specific feature and kernel version notes.
- Offers a comprehensive user guide covering frequent operations and common troubleshooting.
